purpose: Small regression sentinels for deployment changes; not a broad capability claim.
batch_size_policy: Backend-selected for throughput is allowed only when logits and scores are proven identical to batch_size=1; record the actual value.

harness.task_configuration_policy: Use the unmodified task definitions shipped by the pinned release and archive their resolved configuration/hash with each result.

tasks.window_policy: Use the pinned harness rolling-loglikelihood task unchanged; record model max_length and effective stride/window metadata.
tasks.license: CC-BY-SA-3.0 and GFDL are listed by the public dataset card

tasks.scoring: Harness multiple-choice conditional loglikelihood and normalization from the pinned task definition.
tasks.license: MIT as stated in the public dataset card

tasks.scoring: Harness multiple-choice conditional loglikelihood and normalization from the pinned task definition.
tasks.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 as stated in the public dataset card

excluded_candidates.reason: The public dataset page and merged licensing discussion expose inconsistent rendered license metadata. Reconsider only after the exact artifact license is independently resolved and recorded.

execution_policy.dataset_cache: External or ignored cache only; do not commit third-party rows.
execution_policy.sample_log_policy: Keep third-party prompts and continuations out of public Git; commit only aggregate metrics, hashes, provenance, and permitted excerpts.
execution_policy.reporting: Label limited runs with their exact limit and selection policy. Do not compare them with full canonical benchmark scores.
